mustang.title: NACA TN 1044 · P-51B usable maneuver lift
mustang.figure: Figure 6, middle panel, right-hand CL scale
mustang.readingMethod: Rounded visual cross-sections of the overlapping plotted traces. Bands include line and reading spread. The fitting curve uses the midpoint at each fit Mach. Entire check Mach sections are excluded from interpolation knots. They are previously exposed same-report shape checks.
mustang.qualification: Gradual maneuvers, throttled engine, high propeller pitch and carefully finished P-51B. The plotted values represent usable lift at the report’s stall or buffet criterion. The bands pool altitudes. They do not identify an altitude-specific polar or exact powered lift for 43-24777. The altitude-dependent lower Mach gate trims unsupported low-speed combinations. One-g stall uses the separate established model.

sensitivity.qualification: Independent engineering perturbations of each aircraft's maneuver lift, available propulsive power and added drag above 1 G. Use the NACA graph spread where it exceeds the chosen lift perturbation. The resulting ranges describe the tested assumptions.
